attempts.text:
Indraneel Deshpande

indraneeldeshpande@gmail.com
Phone: 9619292103
LinkedIn: linkedin. com/in/indraneel-deshpande

Address: Mumbai, Maharashtra, 421301

Education

Indian Institute of Technology, Indore 2016 - 2020
Bachelor of Technology in Metallurgy Engineering and Materials Science

Professional Experience

Associate, Neo Wealth and Asset Management, Mumbai Jun 2025 - Present

e Played a key role in scaling the structured products book from inception to 100 Cr AUM, covering principal-
protected products linked to equity indices and commodities such as Gold.

e Helped price and test structured products, including principal-protected notes constructed using vanilla options on
equity indices and commodity underlyings.

e Developed a realistic end-to-end simulation incorporating all cost components (option premiums, hedging costs, funding,
transaction costs) to assess product feasibility before launch.

e Automated daily reporting for the structured products book, tracking product performance metrics and real-time
risk exposures across the portfolio.

e Collaborated with traders to build a PnL attribution framework decomposing option position performance into
Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega, Vanna, Volga, and Residual PnL components, enabling precise risk factor iden-
tification.

e Worked with traders to backtest strategies including short volatility and other derivatives-based approaches; improved
strategy Sharpe ratio through dynamic hedging overlays and systematic position sizing to control tail risk and
drawdowns.

Quantitative Strategist, Skylife Research, Mumbai Oct 2024 - May 2025

e Designed and implemented Event-driven and Short volatility trades based on statistical analysis of implied-realized
volatility spread; used Monte Carlo simulations on straddles to generate robust PnL distribution estimates across
multiple price paths.

e Conducted volatility research across equity indices and Nifty 50 stocks, identifying clustering patterns, seasonality, and
price ranges; developed OHLC-based volatility forecasts for positional option trading.

e Built fixed and floating strike volatility surfaces and a Spot-Vol scenario grid to extract ATM dynamics, skew
evolution, and vol-of-vol metrics for derivative pricing and trade timing.

e Developed and backtested Momentum and Low Volatility factor portfolios with transaction cost modeling; imple-
mented risk controls to mitigate momentum crashes and improve Sharpe ratio.

e Conducted network analysis on equity markets using graph theory, measuring centrality metrics to improve portfolio
diversification.

Quantitative Research Intern, Decibel Capital, New York (Remote) Jul 2022 - Aug 2022

e Implemented Black-Scholes pricing and calculated implied volatility via Newton-Raphson across a dataset of
over a million Nifty option prices; attributed Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Vega, Theta) to PnL for straddle strategies.

e Analyzed futures data and implemented a Time-to-expiry function to assess the impact on ATM straddles; leveraged
PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB for efficient data storage and retrieval.

Summer Intern, Zone Startups India, Bombay Stock Exchange May 2019 - Jul 2019

e Researched startups across FinTech, Energy, and Personal Finance for alignment with accelerator programs; compiled
reports on CSR programs and government schemes such as NIDHI SSS.

e Facilitated strategic partnerships between clients and technology startups with expertise in machine learning.



Intern, Catalyst Partners, Mumbai Dec 2018 - Jan 2019

Researched startup decks and funding histories using Venture Intelligence and Tracxn; facilitated investor-client con-
nections to support the firm’s strategic advisory services.

Projects

Derivatives and Volatility

Developed an Excel model to replicate the payoff of an option using Monte Carlo simulation.
Calculated Greeks and performed Delta, Theta, Gamma, and Residual PnL attribution to a call option using VBA.
Simulated Delta hedging strategies and calculated cumulative PnL in Excel.

Generated multiple stock paths with the same volatility using Geometric Brownian Motion and observed Path
dependency by calculating Delta hedging PnL using Python.

Wrote functions for different types of volatility, analyzed the volatility distribution, explored volatility clustering,
and compared 30-day Nifty vol to India VIX.

Equity Portfolio Optimization

Developed a framework for portfolio optimization using the Markowitz Mean-Variance approach with numpy and
cvxpy, plotting Portfolio Return vs. Risk for different Risk aversion coefficients.

Generated a Resampled efficient frontier through Monte Carlo simulation; calculated key risk metrics: Sharpe
ratio, VaR, and CVaR.

Enhanced portfolio optimization (EPO) for 15 stocks based on Pedersen’s paper using shrinkage (w = 0.75), achieving
Sharpe ratio of 1.67 over standard MVO; applied Ledoit-Wolf and Ridge regularization to improve Sample Covariance
matrix conditioning.

Constructed Equal Risk Contribution portfolios via Risk Budgeting; applied PCA to build Eigenportfolios and
created a Barra-aligned Factor exposure matrix with factor covariance and idiosyncratic variance.

Skills

Quantitative Analysis: Portfolio optimization, Factor modeling, Risk measurement, Monte Carlo simulation, Statis-
tical Analysis, Derivatives, Volatility, Structured Products.

Programming Languages: Python (numpy, pandas, matplotlib, cvxpy, networkx), SQL (PostgreSQL), VBA, Bash.
Tools & Technologies: Linux, Jupyter Notebook, Excel, Solver.

Methodologies: Mean-Variance optimization, Covariance matrix shrinkage, Risk budgeting, Multi-factor modeling,
Delta Hedging, PnL Attribution, Momentum Strategy Design.

Collaboration: Effective teamwork with traders, risk, portfolio, and business managers to implement quantitative
models.

Publications

Chemistry Journal: Substituents Effects of Organic Linkers on Rotational Energy Barriers in Metal-Organic Frame-
works

Relevant Courses

Linear Algebra (IIT Indore)

Probabilistic and Statistical Methods in Civil Engineering (IIT Indore)

Computational Methods in Pricing and Model Calibration (Columbia University, Coursera)
Advanced Topics in Derivative Pricing (Columbia University, Coursera)

Optimization Methods in Asset Management (Columbia University, Coursera)




� Neural Networks and Deep Learning

� Improving Deep Neural Networks: Hyperparameter tuning, Regularization and Optimization

� Structuring Machine Learning Projects

3
